prompt.project_info: Create a social live-stream interface screenshot featuring an adult beauty host broadcasting from a dim indoor room.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with tied-back dark hair and a natural beauty-host presentation, seated close to the camera with one hand near her cheek. Preserve her approved adult identity and calm engaged expression.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical mobile live-stream screen with host image centered, profile/avatar area at top, follower/viewer count, live ranking and gift panels, scrolling comments at lower left, action icons, and bottom comment field. Preserve the observed Chinese/Douyin-style interface structure in the preview rather than inventing a different UI.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft indoor low-light beauty-stream atmosphere, gentle face illumination, realistic phone-camera texture, authentic social broadcasting mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 mobile interface composition, photorealistic host image, coherent UI layers, readable hierarchy, realistic icons and translucent comment overlays, no unrelated branding or fabricated text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Generate a 9:16 social live-stream interface screenshot featuring an adult beauty host broadcasting from a dim indoor room. She has tied-back dark hair, sits close to the camera with one hand near her cheek, and maintains a calm engaged expression. Center the photorealistic host image within a mobile live interface with profile/avatar area, viewer or follower count, live ranking and gift panels, scrolling comments, action icons, and bottom comment field. Preserve the observed Chinese/Douyin-style interface structure, soft indoor face illumination, realistic phone-camera texture, and authentic social-broadcasting mood. Do not invent unrelated branding or random readable text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, celebrity likeness, identity drift, illegible UI, random text, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, blurry, low quality, distorted features, bad anatomy, extra limbs, extra fingers, deformed, watermark

assets.name: approved adult live-stream host
assets.usage: Preserve approved adult face, hair, expression, pose, and natural styling; replaceable with another approved adult host.

assets.name: Chinese mobile live-stream interface
assets.usage: Preserve observed top bars, comments, gifts, icons, and translucent overlays; replaceable only with equivalent platform UI structure.

assets.name: dim indoor streaming room
assets.usage: Preserve dark room, bed/background context, and soft face lighting; replaceable with an equivalent streaming environment.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the matching preview to lock adult host identity, UI arrangement, and room lighting. Preserve face, hair, interface hierarchy, and comment/gift placement. UI text may be replaced with equivalent non-misleading text; do not add logos, unrelated platform marks, or unsupported claims.
